For HVAC wholesalers and plumbing merchants across Europe, stocking the right wireless boiler thermostats is always a balancing act. Honeywell Home and Salus Controls have long been the go-to choices — but rising costs and shrinking margins are pushing many distributors to look for smarter alternatives.

If you want a reliable, high-margin, trade-only option that matches the performance of the big names, the E-TOP WT-02 Programmable Wireless Room Thermostat is gaining strong traction among B2B players.  
E-TOP WT-02 wireless boiler thermostat wiring diagram in European utility room, a direct alternative to Honeywell T3R and SALUS RT510RF for B2B wholesale

## 1. 868MHz RF Reliability – Same Standard as Salus & Honeywell [...] Installers trust Salus (e.g. RT510RF) and Honeywell (e.g. T3R, DT4R) mainly for their stable wireless performance. Most experienced engineers avoid standard Wi-Fi thermostats in European homes with thick brick walls and solid floors.

The E-TOP WT-02 uses the exact same 868MHz RF frequency to ensure:

Extended Range: Open line-of-sight range up to 300 meters.

Superior Penetration: Strong wall and floor penetration for multi-story buildings.

Fully Offline Operation: The link between transmitter and receiver stays active even if the home internet drops out.

This dramatically reduces callback complaints and costly after-sales visits for your trade customers.

## 2. True Universal Compatibility [...] Contact Us to Request an E-TOP WT-02 Sample

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Q1: Can the E-TOP WT-02 replace a Honeywell T3R or Salus RT510RF without changing the boiler wiring?

### A: Yes. Since the E-TOP WT-02 receiver uses the standard 3A volt-free (dry contact) relay connection method common to European heating systems, the wiring configuration is identical to the Salus RT510RF or Honeywell T3R. Contractors can swap the units seamlessly using the existing boiler control terminals.

The T3R wireless thermostat is a new type of thermostat from Honeywell replacing the older models CM 927, CM 907, CM727, and CM707. It is designed for the automatic control of heating systems in flats and houses according to an adjustable time schedule and temperature. It is compatible with heat sources controlled by a volt-free contact (24 / 230 V), such as gas boilers, combination boilers, and heat pumps. It is also suitable for controlling zone valves.

The T3R thermostat is in a wireless design and the package also includes a wireless switching unit. The control unit can be mounted directly on the wall or into an installation box. [...] The T3R is the ideal solution for anyone who requires reliable and precise control with a modern appearance, simple programming, and operation.

 7-day program
 Ability to set 4 independent time periods for each day of the week
 Information on room temperature
 OFF mode includes frost protection at a minimum of 5°C – the pipes in the house will never freeze
 Automatic time setting for "summer time"
 The thermostat is powered by alkaline batteries 2 x 1.5 V IEC LR6 (AA)
 Battery life is 2 years, low battery warning
 Wireless unit powered by 230 V
 Setting range 5…35°C
 Measurement accuracy 0.5°C

Not suitable for electric heating applications(240 V).

results.title: Honeywell Homes T3, T3M & T3R
results.content:
The T3, T3M & T3R thermostats are designed to provide automatic time and temperature control of heating systems in homes and apartments. The T3 It’s compatible with 24‐ 230V on/off appliances such as gas boilers, combi‐boilers and heat pump. Also works with zone valve applications but not with electric heating (240V). The T3M and T3R versions support also OpenTherm® appliances.
The T4 and T4M are for wired on the wall installations and the T4R for wireless installations. T3R exist of a thermostat and a Receiver box.
The solution is designed with the installer in mind and includes a receiver module with mounting options for directly on the wall or on a wall box. Wiring can be from below or from the back by lifting the terminal platform, which makes installation quick and easy.
